newsitem.title: UK: Flexible labour important for UK productivity - CBI.
newsitem.headline: Flexible labour important for UK productivity - CBI.

text.p: Increased investment in new technology and greater labour flexibility have been the main sources of recent productivity growth for British firms, according to a survey by the Confederation of British Industry.

Of 708 manufacturing and service firms surveyed during the second half of last year, 53 percent said investment in new plant and technology was a very important source of their productivity growth during the last three years.
Fifty percent said greater labour flexibility was important for productivity growth and 43 percent named better use of existing plant and technology.

The survey showed 53 percent of firms said their productivity and performance had increased at around the same rate as their pay over the last three years, with 38 percent saying their performance had increased faster than their pay.

The nine percent who said performance had increased more slowly than pay said an unwillingness to shed labour and physical capacity constraints were the most important factors in limiting productivity gains.
